name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-07-24, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
